title: National Waterway 15 _Bakreswar Mayurakshi River System:
text:
15. National Waterway 15 _Bakreswar Mayurakshi River System:_

Bakreswar river from Nil Nirjan Dam at Lat 23[o]49‟31”N, Lon
87[o]24‟59”E to confluence of Bakreswar and Mayurakshi rivers
near Talgram village at Lat 23[o] 51‟58”N, Lon 88[o]02‟21”E.

Mayurakshi river from Talgram village to confluence with
Dwarka river near Dakshin Hijal village at Lat 23[o] 58‟22”N, Lon
88[o]09‟21”E.
